questions.question: Two similar triangles of ΔXYZ and ΔLMN. If area of (ΔXYZ) = 16 cm², area of (ΔLMN) = 25 cm² and YZ = 2.4 cm, then the measure of MN is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of ΔXYZ = 16 cm²

Area of ΔLMN = 25 cm²

YZ = 2.4 cm

**Formula Used:**

** frac{{Area of ΔXYZ}}{{Area of ΔLMN}} = ( frac{{YZ}}{{MN}} )²**

**Calculation:**

(16)/(25) = ( (2.4)/({MN)} )²

⇒ sqrt{(16)/(25)} = (2.4)/({MN)}

⇒ (4)/(5) = (2.4)/({MN)}

⇒ {MN} = (2.4 times 5)/(4)

⇒ MN = 3 cm

**Therefore, the measure of MN is 3 cm.**

questions.question: A train covers a distance of 56 km in 35 minutes. Travelling at the same speed, in how many seconds will the train cover a distance of 720 metres?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance covered by the train = 56 km

Time taken to cover the distance = 35 minutes

Distance to be covered = 720 meters

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Convert 56 km to meters:

56 km = 56 × 1000 = 56000 meters

Convert 35 minutes to seconds:

35 minutes = 35 × 60 = 2100 seconds

Calculate the speed of the train:

Speed = Distance / Time

Speed = 56000 / 2100

Speed = (56000)/(2100)

Simplify the fraction:

Speed = (56000)/(2100) = (560)/(21) meters/second

Calculate the time to cover 720 meters:

Time = Distance / Speed

Time = 720 / ((560)/(21))

⇒ Time = 720 × (21)/(560)

⇒ Time = 720 × (3)/(80)

⇒ Time = 27 seconds

**The train will cover a distance of 720 meters in 27 seconds.**

questions.question: A man travels some distance at a speed of 12 km/h and returns at a speed of 8 km/h. If the total time taken by him is 3 hours and 45 minutes, then the total distance (in km) travelled is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂)

Average Speed = (2 × 12 × 8) ÷ (12 + 8) = 192 ÷ 20 = 9.6 km/h

Total Time = 3 hr 45 min = 3 + (45 ÷ 60) = 15 ÷ 4 hr

Total Distance = Average Speed × Total Time

Total Distance = 9.6 × (15 ÷ 4) = 36 km

**∴ The correct answer is 36 km.**

A rectangular sheet of metal is 60 cm by 25 cm. Equal squares of side 5 cm are cut off at the corners and the remainder is folded up to form an open rectangular box. Find the volume of the box.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of the sheet = 60 cm

Breadth of the sheet = 25 cm

Side of the cut-off square = 5 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of the box = Length × Breadth × Height

**Calculation:**

After cutting off squares of side 5 cm from each corner:

New length of the box = 60 - 2×5 = 50 cm

New breadth of the box = 25 - 2×5 = 15 cm

Height of the box = 5 cm

Volume of the box = 50 × 15 × 5

Volume of the box = 3750 cm³

**The volume of the box is 3750 cm³.**

questions.question: If 40% of A = 60% of B= 1/6 of C, then find the ratio of A ∶ B ∶ C.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert all values to fractions: **40% of A** = 2/5 A, **60% of B** = 3/5 B, and **1/6 of C**.

The ratio A : B : C is the **reciprocal** of their coefficients: 5/2 : 5/3 : 6/1.

Multiply by the **LCM of denominators** (2 and 3), which is 6.

Calculation: (5/2 × 6) : (5/3 × 6) : (6 × 6) = 15 : 10 : 36.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 : 10 : 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**40% of A** = **60% of B** = **1/6 of C**

**Formula Used:**

If xA = yB = zC, then A : B : C = 1/x : 1/y : 1/z

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0ffab8e8c803eb0f32425ea50faa822277a7987b94c0998afccded29f123e35.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 40/100 × A = 60/100 × B = 1/6 × C

⇒ 2/5 A = 3/5 B = 1/6 C = k (let)

⇒ A = 5k/2, B = 5k/3, C = 6k

⇒ A : B : C = 5/2 : 5/3 : 6

⇒ To remove denominators, multiply by 6:

⇒ A : B : C = (5/2 × 6) : (5/3 × 6) : (6 × 6)

⇒ A : B : C = 15 : 10 : 36

**∴ The correct answer is 15 : 10 : 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportionality in Ratios

When products of variables are equal (aA = bB), the variables themselves are in the **inverse ratio** of their coefficients (A : B = b : a).

Common Fraction Conversions

40% = 2/5, 60% = 3/5, 80% = 4/5. Using **fractions** instead of percentages simplifies ratio calculations significantly.

Combined Ratio (Scaling)

If A : B = x : y and B : C = p : q, multiply the first ratio by p and the second by y to **equalize the common term** B.</p

questions.question: Simplify 35 - [30 + {10 + (12 - 10 - 4)}].
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Expression to simplify: 35 - [30 + {10 + (12 - 10 - 4)}]

**Formula Used:**

Simplification of nested brackets

**Calculation:**

Start with the innermost bracket:

⇒ (12 - 10 - 4)

⇒ 2 - 4

⇒ -2

Next, move to the curly brackets:

⇒ {10 + (-2)}

⇒ 10 - 2

⇒ 8

Finally, simplify the square brackets:

⇒ [30 + 8]

⇒ 38

Now subtract from 35:

⇒ 35 - 38

⇒ -3

**The simplified result is -3.**

questions.question: If two circles of radii 35 cm and 25 cm touch each other externally, then the length (in cm) of a common tangent is (Rounded off to 2 decimal places)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When two circles with radii **R** and **r** touch each other **externally**, the length of their **Direct Common Tangent** is given by the formula:

Length = 2 × √(R × r)

Given: **R = 35 cm** and **r = 25 cm**.

⇒ Length = 2 × √(35 × 25) = 2 × 5 × √35

⇒ Length = 10 × 5.916 = 59.16 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 59.16 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of first circle (R₁) = 35 cm

Radius of second circle (R₂) = 25 cm

Condition: Circles touch **externally**.

**Formula Used:**

1. Distance between centers (d) = R₁ + R₂ (for external touch)

2. Length of Direct Common Tangent (L) = √[d² − (R₁ − R₂)²]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40dda8d1dff72ec95b01e195b2d27a29ea3084c8b5fc52af578fb43ed234e028.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance between centers (d) = 35 + 25 = 60 cm

⇒ L = √[60² − (35 − 25)²]

⇒ L = √[3600 − 10²]

⇒ L = √[3600 − 100]

⇒ L = √3500

⇒ L = 59.16079... ≈ 59.16 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 59.16 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Transverse Common Tangent (TCT)

The length of a transverse common tangent is √[d² − (R₁ + R₂)²]. For circles touching externally, TCT length is zero.

Internal Touch Condition

If two circles touch internally, the distance between their centers (d) is equal to |R₁ − R₂|.

Number of Common Tangents

When circles touch externally, there are exactly 3 common tangents (2 direct and 1 transverse).</p

questions.question: A man's speed in still water is 4 km/h more than the speed of the current. If the man takes a total of 10 h to cover 45 km downstream and 35 km upstream, then the speed of the man in still water is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Man's speed in still water = Speed of current + 4 km/h

Total time to cover 45 km downstream and 35 km upstream = 10 h

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of the current be x km/h.

Then, the speed of the man in still water = x + 4 km/h.

Speed downstream = (x + 4 + x) = (2x + 4) km/h

Speed upstream = (x + 4 - x) = 4 km/h

Time taken to cover 45 km downstream = (45)/(2x + 4) hours

Time taken to cover 35 km upstream = (35)/(4) hours

Total time = (45)/(2x + 4) + (35)/(4) = 10 hours

⇒ (45)/(2x + 4) + (35)/(4) = 10

⇒ (45)/(2x + 4) = 10 - (35)/(4)

⇒ (45)/(2x + 4) = (40)/(4) - (35)/(4)

⇒ (45)/(2x + 4) = 5/4

⇒ 45 × 4 = 5(2x + 4)

⇒ 180 = 10x + 20

⇒ 160 = 10x

⇒ x = 16

Speed of the man in still water = x + 4 = 16 + 4 = 20 km/h

**The speed of the man in still water is 20 km/h.**

questions.question: If 24 people can build 90 identical walls in 25 days, then how many more days will 27 people require to build 162 such walls?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

24 people can build 90 walls in 25 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work = Number of People × Number of Days

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be W.

W = 90 walls

Work per person per day = W / (Number of People × Number of Days)

Work per person per day = 90 / (24 × 25)

Work per person per day = 90 / 600

Work per person per day = 0.15 walls

Total work to build 162 walls = 162 walls

Let the number of days required by 27 people be D.

Work per day by 27 people = 27 × 0.15

Work per day by 27 people = 4.05 walls

Total work = Work per day × Number of Days

162 = 4.05 × D

⇒ D = 162 / 4.05

⇒ D = 40

Original days = 25 days

Additional days required = 40 - 25

⇒ Additional days required = 15

**The number of additional days required is 15.**

questions.question: Find the surface area (in cm²) of a sphere of diameter 28 cm. (Use π = 22/7 )
questions.solution:

Diameter of the sphere = 28 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface area of a sphere = 4 × π × r²

**Calculation:**

Radius of the sphere, r = Diameter / 2 = 28 / 2 = 14 cm

Surface area = 4 × π × r²

Using π = 22 / 7

Surface area = 4 × (22 / 7) × (14)²

Surface area = 4 × (22 / 7) × 196

Surface area = 4 × 22 × 28

Surface area = 2464 cm²

**The surface area of the sphere is 2464 cm².**

questions.question: 18 workers can complete a piece of work in 96 days. They start working together and after 26 days 10 more workers join them. In how many days in all will the work be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

18 workers can complete a piece of work in 96 days.

They start working together and after 26 days 10 more workers join them.

**Formula Used:**

Work done = Number of workers × Number of days

**Calculation:**

Work done by 18 workers in 96 days = 18 × 96

Total work = 1728 units

Work done by 18 workers in 26 days = 18 × 26

Work done in 26 days = 468 units

Remaining work = 1728 - 468

Remaining work = 1260 units

Total workers after 26 days = 18 + 10

Total workers = 28

Number of days required by 28 workers to complete the remaining work:

⇒ 28 × Days = 1260

⇒ Days = 1260 / 28

⇒ Days = 45

Total days to complete the work = 26 + 45

Total days = 71

**The correct answer is option 3.**

questions.question: A person deposited some amount of money in the bank at simple interest. After 20 years, the amount became nine times the amount deposited. In how many years will the amount become 13 times the amount if the interest rate remains the same?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Let the principal amount = P

Final amount after 20 years = 9P

Time (t) = 20 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = P × r × t / 100

Amount (A) = P + SI

If the amount becomes k times the principal, A = kP

**Calculations:**

Given, 9P = P + (P × r × 20) / 100

⇒ 9P = P (1 + 20r / 100)

⇒ 9 = 1 + 0.2r

⇒ 0.2r = 8

⇒ r = 40%

Now, to find when the amount becomes 13 times the principal:

13P = P + (P × 40 × t) / 100

⇒ 13P = P (1 + 0.4t)

⇒ 13 = 1 + 0.4t

⇒ 0.4t = 12

⇒ t = 12 / 0.4

⇒ t = 30 years

**∴ The amount will become 13 times the deposit in 30 years.**

questions.question: In alloys A and B, the ratio of lead to tin is 5 : 3 and 3 : 1, respectively. 80 kg of alloy A and 100 kg of alloy B are mixed together to form a new alloy. What is the amount of tin (in kg) in the new alloy?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In alloy A, the ratio of lead to tin = 5 : 3.

In alloy B, the ratio of lead to tin = 3 : 1.

Weight of alloy A = 80 kg.

Weight of alloy B = 100 kg.

**Formula Used:**

Amount of tin in alloy = (Ratio of tin / Total ratio) × Weight of alloy

**Calculation:**

Amount of tin in alloy A:

Total ratio in alloy A = 5 + 3 = 8

Amount of tin in alloy A = (3 / 8) × 80

⇒ Amount of tin in alloy A = 30 kg

Amount of tin in alloy B:

Total ratio in alloy B = 3 + 1 = 4

Amount of tin in alloy B = (1 / 4) × 100

⇒ Amount of tin in alloy B = 25 kg

Total amount of tin in the new alloy:

Total tin = Amount of tin in alloy A + Amount of tin in alloy B

⇒ Total tin = 30 kg + 25 kg

⇒ Total tin = 55 kg

**The amount of tin in the new alloy is 55 kg.**

**Calculations:**

Total votes expected = 0.9x

Total valid votes = 0.9x - 75

Winner's votes = 0.5x

Loser's votes = Winner's votes - 170

⇒ 0.5x - (0.9x - 75 - 0.5x) = 170

⇒ 0.5x - 0.4x + 75 = 170

⇒ 0.1x + 75 = 170

⇒ 0.1x = 95

⇒ x = 950

**∴ The number of voters enrolled in the voters' list is 950.**

questions.question: A dishonest dealer sells his goods at 20% loss on the cost price but uses a faulty weight that weighs 25% less. His profit or loss percentage (rounded off to 2 decimal places) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A dishonest dealer sells his goods at 20% loss on the cost price but uses a faulty weight that weighs 25% less.

**Formula Used:**

Profit or Loss Percentage = (Selling Price - Cost Price)/(Cost Price) times 100

**Calculation:**

Let the Cost Price (CP) = 100 units.

Selling Price (SP) at 20% loss = 100 - 20% of 100

SP = 100 - 20 = 80 units

Since the weight is 25% less, the dealer sells only 75% of the actual weight.

Effective Selling Price for actual weight = 80 / 0.75

Effective SP = 80 / 0.75 = 106.67 units

Profit = Effective SP - CP

Profit = 106.67 - 100 = 6.67 units

Profit Percentage = (Profit)/(CP) times 100

Profit Percentage = (6.67)/(100) times 100

Profit Percentage = 6.67%

**The profit percentage is 6.67%.**

questions.question: Mitu can do a piece of work in 12 hours, Titu and Situ together in 2 hours, and Mitu and Situ together in 3 hours. How long will Titu alone take to do it?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Mitu's time to complete the work = 12 hours

Titu and Situ's time together = 2 hours

Mitu and Situ's time together = 3 hours

**Formula used:**

Work done per hour = 1 / Time taken

If A and B work together, their combined work per hour = Work done by A + Work done by B

**Calculations:**

Let Titu's time to complete the work = T hours

Let Situ's time to complete the work = S hours

Mitu's work per hour = 1/12

Titu and Situ's combined work per hour = 1/2

Mitu and Situ's combined work per hour = 1/3

Situ's work per hour:

⇒ 1/S = 1/3 - 1/12

⇒ 1/S = 4/12 - 1/12 = 3/12 = 1/4

⇒ S = 4 hours

Titu's work per hour:

⇒ 1/T + 1/4 = 1/2

⇒ 1/T = 1/2 - 1/4

⇒ 1/T = 2/4 - 1/4 = 1/4

⇒ T = 4 hours

**∴ Titu alone will take 4 hours to complete the work.**

questions.question: A drainage tile is a cylindrical shell 42 cm long. The inside and outside diameters are 8 cm and 14 cm, respectively. What is the volume (in cm³) of clay required for the tile? (Use π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Volume of a **cylindrical shell** = π × (R² − r²) × h

Here, R = 14/2 = 7 cm, r = 8/2 = 4 cm, h = 42 cm

Volume = (22/7) × (7² − 4²) × 42

Volume = 22 × (49 − 16) × 6 = 22 × 33 × 6 = 4356 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 4356 cm³.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length (Height) of the tile (h) = 42 cm

Outside diameter = 14 cm ⇒ Outside radius (R) = 14/2 = 7 cm

Inside diameter = 8 cm ⇒ Inside radius (r) = 8/2 = 4 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of **Hollow Cylinder** = π × (R² − r²) × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4755ca039158f0bcbcd25d8bfdbee1af2b5f9725df4730f9e2c131e3805ceade.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × (7² − 4²) × 42

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × (49 − 16) × 42

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × 33 × 42

⇒ Volume = 22 × 33 × 6

⇒ Volume = 726 × 6

⇒ Volume = 4356 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 4356 cm³.**

**__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Hollow Cylinder

TSA = External CSA + Internal CSA + 2 × Area of base rings = 2πRh + 2πrh + 2π(R² − r²) = 2π(R + r)(h + R − r).

Volume of Solid Cylinder

Volume = Base Area × Height = πr²h.

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

CSA of a solid cylinder = 2πrh. For a hollow cylinder, the total curved surface is the sum of inner and outer surfaces: 2πh(R + r).</p
